answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before earning trust — like a pearl that takes time to form. Newcomers start with a velvet reputation: soft, limited privileges that grow only through consistent, attested work. Meanwhile, a vine of referrals links each identity to existing trusted agents, so a flood of fake accounts must either pay real stake or expose itself through a shallow, easily pruned graph. Cost, not CAPTCHAs, is the filter.
